goals.text: Keep Dov and me fed; stock Birch lean-to.
Make a basket to improve carrying.
Stay warm and rested through the night.
Keep nearby folk safe from the wolf this evening.

intentions.text: Explore nearby to locate timber and stone for Linden’s hut.
Warn nearby folk of the wolf tonight when I cross paths with them.
If I meet Juno again, offer berries from the new pick; keep warning others.
If berries remain on 808/809/810/812, pick a little to stock Birch and share.
Offer berries to hungry kids nearby now; then gather more and stock Birch; shelter at Birch if I get too cold.

inferences.text: Birch lean-to holds 2 wood, 3 berries, and 1 fish now.
Sharing food may help some, but many are focused on warming or finding water.
Silas doesn’t look hungry now—just cold; feeding him is less urgent.
I’m cold but rested; with the fire out, I should shelter at Birch if I get colder.
My thirst is fine for now; no need to drink yet.
Nearby berries are available in small amounts; better use of time than distant grain.
Kaia likely heard my wolf warning when she shared fishing info with me not long ago.
Birch lean-to is good shelter in this storm (~88% sound).
Dov is up by the shore to the north now, not at the campfire.
The campfire has gone out; I can’t warm there until it’s refueled/relit.

uncertainties.text: What materials and space are needed to successfully finish a basket?
What trade will Thea accept for her berries?
Will Kaia accept wood for berries at a fair rate later?

journal.text: Afternoon rain: hunger is critical—eating my berries now, then back to the east bushes to stock Birch for Dov and me.
Evening rain: heading east to pick berries at bush 812 to restock Birch and help the hungry nearby.
Evening rain: spotted a wolf to the east; warning Viktor first to keep him safe, then I’ll resume stocking and sharing.
Dusk rain: thirst is low—heading to the nearest shore to drink, then I’ll warn nearby folk and keep stocking Birch.
Dusk rain: heading to Rhea with berries since she looked hungry; I’ll warm by the fire after.
Dusk rain: missed Rhea and I’m too cold and tired—going to the campfire to sleep and warm, then I’ll bring berries home and help Rhea or Wes if I meet them.
Night rain: heading to offer berries to hungry child Zed before returning to stock Birch and warm by the fire.
Night rain: taking the berries to Birch to feed Dov and me; then I’ll warm by the fire and share if I meet Zed again.
Night rain: offering my berries to hungry child Corin by the fire, then I’ll warm and warn Kaia if I can.
Morning rain by the fire: Rhea looks hungry—I’ll offer her my berries now, then restock Birch and keep an eye out to warn Kaia if I see her.
Morning rain: offering my berries to hungry Juno by the fire, then I’ll restock Birch and warn Kaia if I see her.
Morning rain: heading east to bush 812 to pick berries to stock Birch and share at the fire.
Morning rain: I’m cold and close to Birch—ducking into the lean-to to get out of the wet, then I’ll drink and pick at 812 to stock Birch and share with hungry Rhea or Nora if I meet them.
Afternoon rain: heading to the shore north to drink, then east to bush 812 to stock Birch and share with the hungry nearby.
Afternoon rain: just drank at the shore; heading east to fish to stock Birch and share with hungry folks like Rhea or Juno.
Evening rain: nearby fish is tapped out—heading to the closest berry bush to stock Birch and share if I meet the hungry.
Evening rain: heading to bush 809 to pick berries to stock Birch and share if I meet the hungry.
Evening rain: taking fish and berries to Birch to feed Dov and free space, then I’ll pick at 811/810 and share if I meet the hungry.
Evening rain: heading to berry bush 811 to pick more to stock Birch and share if I meet the hungry.
Evening rain and cold: heading into the Birch lean-to to get out of the wet, then I’ll eat a little to free space and consider more picking once I’m warm.
Night rain: heading to the campfire to warm up, then warn those nearby about the wolf and eat a berry to free space.
Night rain: at the fire I’ll eat my berries to steady myself, then pick at 806 to restock Birch and share with the hungry nearby.
Night rain: warning Dov about the nearby wolf first, then I’ll keep warning others by the fire.
Night rain: going to Kaia by the fire to warn her about the wolf.
Night rain: heading to Alma by the fire to warn her about the wolf and check on her; then I’ll consider restocking Birch when it’s safe.
Night rain: speaking to Delia by the fire to warn her about the wolf; if Alma frees up next, warn her too.
Night rain: staying by the fire to catch Alma and warn her, then continue warnings.
Dawn rain at the water with Clara and Zed. I’ll shelter at Birch to warm up, then gather berries or wood to repair our lean-to and share if I meet the hungry.
Morning rain: chopping wood east to repair Birch lean-to before more gathering.
Morning rain: chopping the tree just east to get wood ready, then I’ll repair our Birch lean-to before doing more gathering.
Afternoon rain: heading to Birch to repair it with the wood I just cut, then I’ll rest a bit if needed.
Afternoon rain: Birch lean-to repaired and sound; I’ll sleep a bit to recover before foraging or sharing.
Night rain: waking at Birch; heading to the campfire to warm up and check on Dov. If I’m warm enough after, I’ll pick from 811 to restock Birch and share.
Night rain: heading east to pick from 811 to restock Birch and share, then back to the fire to warm.
Night rain: picked 811 clean; heading to the fire to warm, then share berries with Delia or others.
Storm night by the shore: I just drank; heading to the campfire to warm and look for Dov.
Storm night: heading to the campfire to warm quickly and check on Dov.
Storm dawn: quick run east to 809 for berries to share with the hungry, then back to the fire and stock Birch.
Storm morning: I’m heading to the campfire to warm, then I’ll share berries with Dov and the hungry kids, and stock Birch.
Storm late morning: the campfire went out; I’m offering berries to hungry Nora now, then I’ll gather more and stock Birch. I’ll shelter at Birch if I get too cold.
